destination.description: The mount point or device path of the USB stick or disk-like device to copy files to.

sources.description: A list of source paths to include in the ukopp job. Each item must be an object with a 'path' field containing a string representing the absolute path on the local filesystem.

retention_count.description: The number of old file versions to keep on the destination media before overwriting or removing older versions.

verify_mode.description: The media verification mode. Valid values are 'full', 'incremental', or 'compare'.

preserve_perms.description: Whether to retain file owners and permissions on the copy media, even if it is a Microsoft file system.
